qs.q: Drift is the angular difference between heading and track measured from
Required track 300°T, drift 8° right, variation 10°W, deviation −4°. What is the required compass heading?
The wind at an airfield is reported as 330/30. What are the components along and across runway 04?
o: 10 kt headwind, 28 kt crosswind from the left
10 kt tailwind, 28 kt crosswind from the left
28 kt headwind, 10 kt crosswind from the right
qs.ex: Runway 04 = 040°. Wind 330 is 70° left of the runway: headwind 30 cos 70 ≈ 10 kt, crosswind 30 sin 70 ≈ 28 kt from the left.

qs.q: The reported surface wind from the tower is 240°/35 kt. Runway 30 (303°M). What is the crosswind component?
The maximum factored crosswind for take-off is 10 kt. What is the acceptable wind at 330° for take-off from runway 09?
qs.ex: Runway 090, wind 330: angle 120°. Crosswind = W × sin 120 ≤ 10 → W ≤ 11.5 kt; book answer 12 kt.

qs.q: The reported wind at an airfield is 270/30. What along-track and across-track components apply for take-off on runway 29?
o: 28 kt tailwind, 10.5 kt from the right
28 kt headwind, 10.5 kt from the left
10.5 kt headwind, 28 kt from the right
qs.ex: Runway 290 with wind 270: 20° left of the nose: headwind 28 kt, crosswind 10.5 kt from the left.

qs.q: X to Y is 120 NM and Y to Z 180 NM. ATD X 1012 UTC, ETA Y 1036 UTC, ATA Y 1032 UTC. TAS 380 kt. What is the ETA at Z, and the forecast and actual HW/TW components?
qs.ex: Actual X→Y 120 NM in 20 min = 360 kt (wind −20); planned 24 min = 300 kt (forecast −80). Y→Z 180 NM at 360 kt = 30 min → 1102.
